prompts.text: Describe this image in as much visual detail as possible. Include subjects, objects, clothing, colors, positions, background, actions, lighting, and any visible text. Do not invent details that are not visible.
Write a concise caption for this image in exactly two sentences. Focus on the main subject and the most important context. Do not add uncertain details.

Describe the spatial relationships in this image. Explain where the main subjects and objects are located relative to each other. Mention foreground, background, left, right, and center when relevant.
Describe the image in detail. Include any readable visible text exactly as it appears. If text is too unclear to read, say it is unclear rather than guessing.
Analyze this image in English using these headings: Main subject; Secondary objects; Actions; Setting; Visible text; One-paragraph caption. Only use visually supported details.
